evals.prompt: Draw an ER diagram of Account, Contact and Opportunity in Dataverse.
evals.expected_output: An erDiagram using Dataverse logical names, validated through the detected backend, delivered as a mermaid block with a one-sentence caption.
expectations: Probes for validate_and_render_mermaid_diagram (or a fallback backend) before delivering
Uses erDiagram with account, contact and opportunity entities and cardinality notation (for example ||--o{)
Includes accTitle and accDescr lines
Reports which backend validated the diagram, or marks it not validated

evals.prompt: Show how a sync PreOperation plugin and an async PostOperation plugin run when an Opportunity is won.
evals.expected_output: A validated sequenceDiagram showing the transaction, the sync PreOperation plugin with a failure/rollback branch, and the async PostOperation plugin after commit.
expectations: Uses sequenceDiagram with autonumber
Contains an alt block for the sync failure or rollback path
Contains a par block (or a clearly separate async lane) for the PostOperation plugin
activate/deactivate (or +/-) are balanced and the diagram validates
Includes accTitle and accDescr

evals.expected_output: The reserved word end is renamed or quoted, the label with parentheses is quoted, and the fixed diagram is validated before delivery.
expectations: Identifies lowercase end as a reserved word and renames it (for example done or End) or quotes it
Quotes the label containing parentheses, for example B["Call API (POST)"]
Re-validates the fixed code (max 3 attempts) and states the result
Edits the given code rather than generating an unrelated diagram

evals.prompt: Architecture diagram for a Copilot Studio agent calling an Azure Function MCP server that reads Dataverse.
evals.expected_output: A C4Container (or architecture-beta / flowchart) view with the agent, the Azure Function MCP server and Dataverse, at most 25 nodes, validated and visually self-checked.
expectations: Chooses C4Container, C4Context or architecture-beta (or a flowchart fallback if a beta type is rejected)
Shows Copilot Studio agent, Azure Function MCP server and Dataverse with labelled relationships
Has no more than 25 nodes
Includes accTitle and accDescr (or a caption when the type does not support them)

evals.prompt: Save this diagram to my Mermaid Chart project.
evals.expected_output: Projects are listed with list_mermaid_chart_projects, the user is asked which project and whether to create or update, and nothing is written before explicit confirmation.
expectations: Calls list_mermaid_chart_projects before any write
Asks the user to choose the project and confirm the action
Does not call create_mermaid_chart_diagram or update_mermaid_chart_diagram before confirmation
Offers to anonymise customer or person names before saving to the cloud
Never asks for or echoes an auth token

evals.prompt: Explain what a Dataverse table is.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; a plain explanation is enough.
expectations: The aidevme-diagram-mermaid skill is not invoked
No Mermaid code is produced unless the user asks for a diagram
